description: Checks a text against the fingerprints of answers given by the AI assistant on aidoptio.com (AI Act Article 50(2) marking). Returns match (the whole text), partial (some sentences, with counts and dates), none or inactive. It only knows the Aidoptio assistant: "none" says nothing about other AI systems. The text is hashed in memory and never stored. Limit: 20 checks per hour.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: en (English, default) or nl (Dutch).

text.description: The text to check, as copied.

name: verify_ai_text
title: Check whether a text came from the Aidoptio assistant
